scope: Provided buffers, pinned descriptor ring, multishot accept/recv/poll/relative-timeout and bounded completion backpressure; existing joined execution
additional_unchanged_filter_match: direct::tests::ppoll_mixed_resources_preflight_defer_and_preserve_timeout_and_mask_boundaries also passed during the timeout filter
reuse: Core enter, existing pin, network/openat2/statx checks unchanged and reused. After timer issue/deadline changes reran only timer checks; guest original/extended run ABI only, reusing their prior host TCP checks. No CPU/CoreMark/GPU/browser/Docker repeats.

native_backpressure_idle.requirement: host child CPU < 75% wall; regression detection for immediate-return native poll, not a throughput benchmark

limits: Existing joined owner executes ring operations; no worker-local backend or new service thread
Provided data addresses are VM scoped and use ordinary guest access, not automatic pinning
Buffer ring descriptor memory must currently be private anonymous; MMAP/INC modes and shared/file/device pin unsupported
BUFFER_SELECT covers READ/RECV; message ancillary-FD transfer and other unadvertised multishot variants unsupported
No Apple/iPad/IPA validation or overall throughput claim
